title: Mapping Overlaps in Benchmarks through Perplexity in the Wild

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance correlations across benchmarks sharing the same question format (e.g., multiple-choice vs. true-or-false) to show that performance agreements are artificially inflated by format rather than underlying capabilities.

Analyzing performance overlaps across benchmarks within the same family (e.g., MMLU vs. BBH) to demonstrate that models exhibit highly correlated performance due to benchmark-orthogonal factors (like post-training contamination) rather than actual shared task design functions.
